For some HTTP request paths, Synapse will ignore extraneous path segments and therefore serve a resource at an unexpected path.

This could allow evasion of external rate-limiting that may be in place.

The Client-Server API (`/_matrix/client`), Federation API (`/_matrix/federation`), Synapse Admin API (`/_synapse/admin`) and Key Server API (`/_matrix/key`) are not affected by this malleability.

### Patches

Update to Synapse 1.157.2 or later.

See the table below for patched versions of [Element Server Suite](https://element.io/en/server-suite), including Long-Term Support (LTS) versions.
|  | 25.10 LTS | 26.4 LTS | Latest |
|:--|--|--|--|
| **ESS Pro** | `25.10.14+lts` | `26.4.9+lts` | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS Classic** | `25.10.09-gui` | `26.04.04-gui` | ⸻ |
| **ESS Community** | ⸻ | ⸻ | `26.7.2` |
| **ESS TI-Messenger** | `25.10.10` | `26.4.5` | `26.7.0` |

### Workarounds

None known.

### Identifiers

- ELEMENTSEC-2026-1703
